text: 查理操纵马达，其余人则用桨帮忙。返航的第一天平静地过去了。第二天，一场暴雨让河水变得凶猛：你们被卷过一道峭壁环绕的河湾，又冲下一段长达一英里的急流。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 32
text: Charlie works the motor and the rest of your group pitch in with paddles. You spend a peaceful first day returning downriver. The next day out, a downpour turns the water savage, whisking you around a cliff-bound bend and down a mile-long sequence of rapids.
